notes.title: We are joining Couch Co-Op Fest
notes.notes:
Hi Pilots,

We have some exciting news for you! As part of the Couch Co-Op Fest, we're thrilled to announce that our game now features multiplayer with co-op mode! Whether you prefer playing side by side on the same couch with a friend or teaming up online, you can now enjoy the action together like never before.

But that’s not all—to celebrate this event, we're offering an incredible 92% discount on the game for a limited time! This is the perfect opportunity to jump in, invite a friend, and experience the thrill of co-op gameplay at an unbeatable price.

Don't miss out on this amazing deal—grab your copy, team up, and take on the challenge together!

See you in the game! 🚀
